text: Admiral Galloway. You have two minutes, captain. Use them well.
Crownwatch is the beating heart of the Tidewatch. Mind you don't make it skip.
The Admiralty is busy, captain. The sea doesn't patrol itself.
A wanted pirate in Crownwatch. Either very brave or very stupid. Commodore Vey handles bounties. Leave.
Captain! The commission suits you. What does the Admiralty need to know?
The captain who unmasked Harrow. The Admiralty does not forget.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Crownwatch: the Admiralty, the drydock, the finest gun deck in the Reach. Every Tidewatch frigate is fitted out here.
Reach six hundred standing with the Tidewatch and you'll hold a commission: a galleon of your own and the coat to match.
The dead. The Court, if it exists. Pirates with ambition. In that order, most days. Some days in a different order.
At present? A captain who calls themself Sovereign. I'm told you know them.
Thirty years at sea. Two wrecks, one mutiny, one battle that history won't remember properly. I remember it. That's enough.
